body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Plantronics introduced 'Voyager Pro plus+', Bluetooth headset optimized for smartphone at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA for 4 days from January 6.

Listening music, pod cast and GPS voice is available at smartphone or mobile device which is supporting A2DP by newly adding A2DP feature. It also notifies remaining phone call time, volume and the state of connection with mobile phone with voice.
This product is designed ergonomically and soft and flexible rubber material is good for skin.

In addition, it delivers natural voice to sender by removing noise of maximum 80dB supporting AudioIQ Sound Level Auto-tuning feature and Wind Smart technology offers smart 'Triple Wind Noise Blocking' functionality.

Multi point technology makes it possible to connect and use 2 mobile phones at the same time. Calling time up to 6 hours, standby up to 5 days and calling distance up to 10m with lithium ion polymer recharge. The weight is 17g.
